params.caption: 🎮 The Game Awards 2026 nominees are out — GTA 6 leads the pack GTA 6 is the most nominated game of the year, with Nintendo also leading the field. Game of the Year contenders include GTA 6, The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time and Resident Evil Requiem. Nominees were picked by a global media jury, and the show streams live from the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles on December 10. 🕒 Nov 17, 2026 · 19:45 (GMT+3) 📰 Sources: GameSpot · Dexerto · VGC · GamesRadar+ 👥 @thegameawards · @RockstarGames · @NintendoAmerica 🏆 React if you've got a GOTY pick · 💬 Who wins it all? #TheGameAwards #GTA6 #Nintendo #GOTY #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
